    value_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (value_type IN ('text', 'boolean', 'integer_or_text', 'text_list')),
    label TEXT UNIQUE,
    ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0),

tables.name: field_value
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE field_value (
    value_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    entry_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES entry(entry_id),
    pronunciation_id TEXT,
    field_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope TEXT NOT NULL,
    value_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('available', 'missing', 'conflict', 'pending_review', 'invalid')),
    value_json TEXT,
    basis TEXT CHECK (basis IN ('source', 'human', 'derived')),
    matched_word TEXT COLLATE BINARY,
    match_type TEXT CHECK (match_type IN ('exact', 'lowercase')),
    reason TEXT,
    review_event_id TEXT REFERENCES review_event(event_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (field_key, scope, value_type) REFERENCES field_definition(field_key, scope, value_type),
    FOREIGN KEY (pronunciation_id, entry_id) REFERENCES pronunciation(pronunciation_id, entry_id),
    CHECK ((scope = 'entry' AND pronunciation_id IS NULL)
        OR (scope = 'pronunciation' AND pronunciation_id IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK ((matched_word IS NULL AND match_type IS NULL)
        OR (matched_word IS NOT NULL AND match_type IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK ((status = 'available' AND value_json IS NOT NULL AND basis IS NOT NULL)
        OR (status <> 'available' AND value_json IS NULL AND basis IS NULL)),
    CHECK (basis IS NULL OR basis <> 'human' OR review_event_id IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK (value_json IS NULL OR CASE WHEN json_valid(value_json) THEN
        CASE value_type
            WHEN 'text' THEN json_type(value_json) = 'text'
            WHEN 'boolean' THEN json_type(value_json) IN ('true', 'false')
            WHEN 'integer_or_text' THEN json_type(value_json) IN ('integer', 'text')
            WHEN 'text_list' THEN json_type(value_json) = 'array'
            ELSE 0
        END ELSE 0 END)
)
